# Sequencing tripwire. A symbol cannot be gated before it exists, so a planned
# entry point cannot be named in required.txt or optional.txt in advance. This
# list closes the hole from the other side: a symbol here that appears in the
# payload without being classified fails the job. Inert until the symbol ships.
#
# Both entries below are now implemented and classified; they stay as the record
# of what was promised before it existed. Add future planned entry points here.
#
# servo_rendering_context_make_current is deliberately NOT listed. It is exported
# and needed by the paint/present sequence, but the embedder's binding does not
# declare it yet; gating it would promise a symbol nobody resolves.
servo_rendering_context_present
servo_rendering_context_resize
